translated_text: Uttering the single syllable Om, which is Brahman, remembering me, one who departs leaving the body attains the supreme goal.
original_text:
ओमित्येकाक्षरं ब्रह्म व्याहरन्मामनुस्मरन्।
यः प्रयाति त्यजन्देहं स याति परमां गतिम्।।8.13।।

translated_text: For the yogi who always thinks of me with single-pointed devotion, I am easy to attain, O Pritha.
original_text:
अनन्यचेताः सततं यो मां स्मरति नित्यशः।
तस्याहं सुलभः पार्थ नित्ययुक्तस्य योगिनः।।8.14।।

translated_text: Having attained me, the great souls do not return to this world of suffering, which is temporary. They have attained perfection, O son of Kunti.
original_text:
मामुपेत्य पुनर्जन्म दुःखालयमशाश्वतम्।
नाप्नुवन्ति महात्मानः संसिद्धिं विद्धि कौन्त्य।।8.15।।

translated_text: From the highest world of Brahma down to the lowest world of earth, all are subject to repeated birth. But having attained me, O son of Kunti, there is no more birth.
original_text:
आब्रह्मभुवनाल्लोकाः पुनरावर्तिनोऽर्जुन।
मामुपेत्य तु कौन्तेय पुनर्जन्म न विद्यते।।8.16।।

translated_text: Those who know the day of Brahma, which lasts a thousand yugas, and the night of a thousand yugas — they know day and night.
original_text:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः।।8.17।।

translated_text: At the coming of day, all manifest things come forth from the unmanifest. At the coming of night, they merge into that which is called the unmanifest.
original_text:
अव्यक्ताद्व्यक्तयः सर्वाः प्रभवन्त्यहरागमे।
रात्र्यागमे प्रलीयन्ते तत्रैवाव्यक्तसङ्ज्ञके।।8.18।।

translated_text: The same multitude of beings, having come into being again and again, helplessly merge at the approach of night and come forth at the approach of day.
original_text:
भूतग्रामः स एवायं भूत्वा भूत्वा प्रलीयते।
रात्र्यागमेऽवशः पार्थ प्रभवत्यहरागमे।।8.19।।

translated_text: But beyond the manifest is the other unmanifest, which is eternal. When all beings perish, it does not perish.
original_text:
परस्तस्मात्तु भावोऽन्योऽव्यक्तोऽव्यक्तात्सनातनः।
यः स सर्वेषु भूतेषु नश्यत्सु न विनश्यति।।8.20।।

translated_text: The unmanifest, called the Imperishable, is said to be the supreme goal. Having reached it, one does not return. That is my supreme abode.
original_text:
अव्यक्तोऽक्षर इत्युक्तस्तमाहुः परमां गतिम्।
यं प्राप्य न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।8.21।।

translated_text: That supreme person, O Pritha, is attainable only through exclusive devotion. In whom all beings dwell, and by whom all this is pervaded.
original_text:
पुरुषः स परः पार्थ भक्त्यालभ्यस्त्वनन्यया।
यस्यान्तःस्थानि भूतानि येन सर्वमिदं ततम्।।8.22।।

translated_text: I shall now declare to you that path — whether by which yogis departing do not return, or by which they return.
original_text:
यत्र काले त्वनावृत्तिमावृत्तिं चैव योगिनः।
प्रयाता यान्ति तं कालं वक्ष्याम्यहमसंशयम्।।8.23।।

translated_text: Those who go by the bright fortnight, by fire, by the day, during the six months of the sun's northern course — they reach Brahman.
original_text:
अग्निर्ज्योतिरहः शुक्लः षण्मासा उत्तरायणम्।
तत्र प्रयाता गच्छन्ति ब्रह्म सम्विदन्ति वै।।8.24।।

translated_text: By smoke, night, the dark fortnight, and the six months of the sun's southern course, the yogi gains the moon-lit world and returns again.
original_text:
धूमो रात्रिस्तथा कृष्णः षण्मासा दक्षिणायनम्।
तत्र चान्द्रमसं ज्योतिर्योगी प्राप्य निवर्तते।।8.25।।

translated_text: These are the bright and dark paths of the world. By the one, one does not return; by the other, one returns.
original_text:
शुक्लकृष्णे गती ह्येते जगतः शाश्वते मते।
एकया यात्यनावृत्तिमन्ययावर्तते पुनः।।8.26।।

translated_text: No yogi, O Pritha, knowing both these paths is ever deluded. Therefore, at all times, be devoted to yoga, O Bharata.
original_text:
नैते सृती पार्थ जानन्योगी मुह्यति कश्चन।
तस्माद्सर्वेषु कालेषु योगानुस्मर भारत।।8.27।।

translated_text: Whatever meritorious results are said to accrue from the Vedas, sacrifices, austerities, and charity — know them all to arise from meditation. One who practices this yoga attains all this, and having attained me, the supreme goal, comes to me.
original_text:
वेदेषु यज्ञेषु तपःसु चैव दानेषु यत्पुण्यफलं प्रोक्तम्।
सिद्धिप्रदं कृष्ण कृपापरं तेन त्वं मत्परः स्यामिति ते प्रोक्तम्।।8.28।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: Now I shall declare to you the most confidential knowledge, O faultless one. Having known this, you will be freed from evil.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
इदं तु ते गुह्यतमं प्रवक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानतृप्तं च यद्ज्ञात्वा मोक्ष्यसेऽशुभात्।।9.1।।

translated_text: This is the sovereign science, the sovereign secret, the most purifier, directly realizable, righteous, and easy to practice.
original_text:
राजविद्या राजगुह्यं पवित्रमिदमुत्तमम्।
प्रत्यक्षावगमं धर्म्यं सुसूक्ष्यं विघ्नबाधनम्।।9.2।।

translated_text: Those who are faithless and devoid of this dharma perish, O best of Bharatas. Rejecting me, they return to the world of death.
original_text:
अश्रद्दधाना धर्मस्यास्य सन्ति भरतर्षभ।
अज्ञानश्रद्धिनस्तेषामधोगच्छन्ति भूतले।।9.3।।

translated_text: All this is pervaded by me in my unmanifest form. All beings are in me, but I am not in them.
original_text:
मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।
ममान्तोऽन्यो न कश्चिदस्ति कश्चन मेऽव्यय।।9.4।।

translated_text: Nor do the beings dwell in me. Behold my divine mystery. My self-preserving power, creating and supporting all beings, does not bind me.
original_text:
न च मे स्वस्थितानीति कर्माणि कर्मसंयुताः।
न च सर्वेषु भूतेषु न विद्धि कर्मणि कर्माणि कर्मसंयुताः।।9.5।।

translated_text: As the great wind, pervading everywhere, dwells always in space, so all beings dwell in me. Understand it thus.
original_text:
यथाकाशस्थितो नित्यं वायुः सर्वत्रगो महान्।
तथा सर्वाणि भूतानि मत्स्थानीत्युपधारय।।9.6।।

translated_text: All beings, O son of Kunti, return to my prakriti at the end of a kalpa. At the beginning of the next kalpa, I send them forth.
original_text:
सर्वभूतानि कौन्तेय प्रकृतिं यान्ति मामिकाम्।
पृच्छावसादे सृज्यमाने पुनः कल्पे लियन्ते तत्रैव व्यक्तसञ्ज्ञके।।9.7।।

translated_text: Presiding over my own prakriti, I send forth this entire multitude of beings again and again, helplessly, by the force of prakriti.
original_text:
प्रकृतिं स्वामवष्टभ्य विसृजामि पुनः पुनः।
भूतग्राममिमं कृत्स्नमवशं प्रकृतेर्वशात्।।9.8।।

translated_text: These actions of mine do not bind me, as I am detached from them, observing the sport of prakriti.
original_text:
न च मां कर्मणी लिम्पन्ति न मे कर्मफले स्पृहा।
न हि मे स्वस्थितं किञ्चित्कर्मण्यनुपदिश्यते।।9.9।।

translated_text: Under my direction, prakriti produces the moving and unmoving worlds. Because of this, O son of Kunti, the world revolves.
original_text:
मायाद्यक्षेण एष प्रकृतिः सूयते सचराचरम्।
हेतुनानेन कौन्तेय जगत्परिवर्तते।।9.10।।

translated_text: The foolish disregard me, dwelling in a human form, not knowing my supreme nature as the imperishable Lord of all.
original_text:
अवजानन्ति मां मूढा मानुषीं तनुमाश्रितम्।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्।।9.11।।

translated_text: Deluded by these qualities, attached to evil deeds, these foolish people, rejected by me, enter the lower, inauspicious paths of birth and death.
original_text:
मोहिता ज्ञानभूमिष्ठाः नरकानीह गच्छन्ति असद्ग्राहवशान्विताः।
प्रत्यक्षदैवत्यस्था दैवतेजोऽहिताः।।9.12।।

translated_text: The great souls, O Pritha, sheltered by my divine nature, worship me with single-pointed minds, knowing me as the imperishable source of all.
original_text:
महात्मानस्तु मां पार्थ दैवीप्रकृतिमाश्रिताः।
भजन्त्यनन्यमनसो ज्ञात्वा भूतादिमव्ययम्।।9.13।।

translated_text: Always chanting my glories, striving with firm resolve, bowing down to me with devotion, they worship me constantly.
original_text:
सततं कीर्तयन्तो मां यतन्तश्च दृढव्रताः।
नमस्यन्तश्च मां भक्त्या नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।।9.14।।

translated_text: Others worship me through the sacrifice of knowledge — as one, as distinct, and as the universal face everywhere.
original_text:
ज्ञानयज्ञेन चाप्यन्ये यजन्तो मामुपासते।
एकत्वेन पृथक्त्वेन बहुधा विश्वतोमुखम्।।9.15।।

translated_text: I am the sacrifice, I am the offering, I am the oblation, I am the medicinal herbs, I am the mantra, I am the clarified butter, I am the fire, and I am the act of offering.
original_text:
अहं क्रतुरहं यज्ञः स्वधाहमहमौषधम्।
मन्त्रोऽहमहमेवाज्यमहमग्निरहं हुतम्।।9.16।।

translated_text: I am the father of this universe, the mother, the support, the grandsire, the purifier, the syllable Om, the Rik, Sama, and Yajur Vedas.
original_text:
पिताहमस्य जगतो माता धाता पितामहः।
वेद्यं पवित्रमोङ्कार ऋक्साम यजुरेव च।।9.17।।

translated_text: I am the goal, the support, the lord, the witness, the abode, the refuge, the friend, the origin, the dissolution, the foundation, and the imperishable seed.
original_text:
गतिर्भर्ता प्रभुः शक्षी निधानं सर्वभूतानाम्।
भवः प्रलयः स्थानं निधानं बीजमव्ययम्।।9.18।।

translated_text: I give heat, I send forth rain, I am immortality and death, I am being and non-being, O Arjuna.
original_text:
तपाम्यहमहं वर्षं निगृह्णाम्युत्सृजामि च।
अमृतं चैव मृत्युश्च सदसच्चाहमर्जुन।।9.19।।

translated_text: Those who are devoted to the three Vedas, drink the soma juice, purified of sin, worshipping through sacrifices, pray for heaven. They attain the world of the king of gods and enjoy divine pleasures.
original_text:
त्रैविद्या मां सोमपाः पापोनयो यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा स्वर्गतिं प्रार्थयन्ते।
ते पुण्यमासाद्य सुरेन्द्रलोकमश्नान्ति दिव्यान्दिवान्देवभुग्वासाः।।9.20।।

translated_text: Having enjoyed that vast heaven, when their merit is exhausted, they enter the world of mortals. Thus, having followed the three Vedas, desiring desires, they attain the cycle of coming and going.
original_text:
ते तं भुक्त्वा स्वर्गलोकं विशालं क्षीणे पुण्ये मर्त्यलोकं विशन्ति।
एवं त्रयीधर्ममनुप्रपन्ना गतागतं कामकामा लभन्ते।।9.21।।

translated_text: For those who worship me alone, thinking of no other, for those who are ever devoted, I secure what they lack and preserve what they have.
original_text:
अनन्याश्चिन्तयन्तो मां ये जनाः पर्युपासते।
तेषां नित्याभियुक्तानां योगक्षेमं वहाम्यहम्।।9.22।।

translated_text: Even those who worship other gods with faith and devotion worship me alone, though not in the proper way, O son of Kunti.
original_text:
ये अप्यन्यदेवता भक्ता यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः।
तेऽपि मामेव कौन्तेय यजन्त्यविधिपूर्वकम्।।9.23।।

translated_text: I am the enjoyer and lord of all sacrifices. They do not truly know me. Understanding this, one becomes liberated.
original_text:
अहं हि सर्वयज्ञानां भोक्ता च प्रभुरेव च।
न तेषां मे विशेषोऽस्ति विद्धि योगविशारद।।9.24।।

translated_text: The worshippers of the gods go to the gods, the worshippers of the ancestors go to the ancestors, the worshippers of beings go to beings, and those who worship me come to me.
original_text:
यान्ति देवव्रता देवान्पितृन्यान्ति पितृव्रताः।
भूतानि यान्ति भूतेज्या यान्ति मद्याजिनोऽपि माम्।।9.25।।

translated_text: Whoever offers me with devotion a leaf, a flower, a fruit, or water — I accept that offering of love from the pure-hearted.
original_text:
पत्रं पुष्पं फलं तोयं यो मे भक्त्या प्रयच्छति।
तदहं भक्त्युपृतमश्नामि प्रयतात्मनः।।9.26।।

translated_text: Whatever you do, whatever you eat, whatever you offer or give away, whatever austerity you practice — do it as an offering to me, O son of Kunti.
original_text:
यत्करोषि यदश्नासि यज्जुहोषि ददासि यत्।
यत्तपस्यसि कौन्तेय तत्कुरुष्व मदर्पणम्।।9.27।।

translated_text: You will be freed from the bondage of action, both good and evil, through this yoga of renunciation. Established in yoga of renunciation, you will be freed and come to me.
original_text:
शुभाशुभफलैर्मोक्ष्यसे कर्मबन्धैश्च समन्विताः।
संन्यासयोगयुक्तात्मा विमुक्तो मामुपैष्यसि।।9.28।।

translated_text: I am equal to all beings. None is hateful or dear to me. But those who worship me with devotion — they are in me, and I am in them.
original_text:
समोऽहं सर्वभूतेषु न मे द्वेष्योऽस्ति न प्रियः।
ये भजन्ति तु मां भक्त्या मयि ते चापि मम प्रियाः।।9.29।।

translated_text: Even if one is of most evil conduct, if they worship me with exclusive devotion, they are to be considered as saintly, for their resolve is right.
original_text:
अपि चेत्सुदुराचारो भजते मामनन्यभाक्।
साधुरेव स मन्तव्यः सम्यग्व्यवसितो हि सः।।9.30।।

translated_text: They quickly become righteous and attain eternal peace. Know for certain, O son of Kunti, that my devotee never perishes.
original_text:
शीघ्रं भवति धर्मात्मा शश्वच्छान्तिं निगच्छति।
कौन्तेय प्रतिजानीहि मे भक्तः प्रणश्यति।।9.31।।

translated_text: Taking refuge in me, even those born of sinful origins — women, vaishyas, and shudras — attain the supreme goal.
original_text:
मां हि पार्थ व्यपाश्रित्य येऽपि स्युः पापयोनयः।
स्त्रियो वैश्यास्तथा शूद्रास्तेऽपि यान्ति परां गतिम्।।9.32।।

translated_text: How much more then the holy Brahmins, the devoted royal sages? Having come to this temporary, unhappy world, be devoted to me.
original_text:
किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पुण्या भक्ता राजर्षयस्तथा।
अनित्यमसुखं लोकमिमं प्राप्य भजस्व माम्।।9.33।।

translated_text: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, sacrifice to me, bow down to me. Thus, united with me and set on me, you will come to me.
original_text:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।9.34।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: Again hear my supreme word, which I shall declare to you as my supreme confidential teaching, because you are dear to me.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
भूय एव महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः।
यत्तेऽहं प्रियमाणाय वक्ष्याम्यनसूयवे।।10.1।।

translated_text: Neither the hosts of gods nor the great sages know my origin, for in every way I am the source of the gods and sages.
original_text:
न मे विदुः सुरगणाः प्रभवं न महर्षयः।
अहमादिर्हि देवानां महर्षीणां च सर्वशः।।10.2।।

translated_text: One who knows me as the unborn, beginningless, and supreme Lord of all worlds — freed from all sins, that person is not deluded among mortals.
original_text:
यो मामजमनादिं च वेत्ति लोकमहेश्वरम्।
असम्मूढः स मर्त्येषु सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते।।10.3।।

translated_text: Intelligence, knowledge, freedom from delusion, forgiveness, truth, control of the senses and mind, pleasure and pain, birth and death, fear and fearlessness.
original_text:
बुद्धिज्ञानमविभ्रान्तिः क्षमा सत्यं दमः शमः।
सुखं दुःखं भवोऽभावो भयं चाभयमेव च।।10.4।।

translated_text: Non-violence, equanimity, contentment, austerity, charity, fame, and disrepute — these various qualities of beings arise from me alone.
original_text:
अहिंसा समता तुष्टिस्तपो दानं यशोऽयशः।
भवन्ति भावा भूतानां मत्त एव पृथग्विधाः।।10.5।।

translated_text: The seven great sages, the four ancient sages, and the Manus — born of my mind — from whom these creatures of the world are descended.
original_text:
महर्षयः सप्त पूर्वे चत्वारो मनवस्तथा।
मद्भावा मानसा जाता येषां लोक इमाः प्रजाः।।10.6।।

translated_text: One who truly knows my divine powers and yoga is united with me by unshakable devotion. There is no doubt about it.
original_text:
एतां विभूतिं योगं च मम यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
स विकल्पेन युक्तो न मामेव विनश्यति।।10.7।।

translated_text: I am the source of all spiritual and material worlds. Everything emanates from me. Knowing this, the wise worship me with devotion.
original_text:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः।।10.8।।

translated_text: With minds fixed on me, life breath surrendered to me, instructing one another, always speaking of me — they are satisfied and delighted.
original_text:
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा बोधयन्तः परस्परम्।
कथयन्तश्च मां नित्यं तुष्यन्ति च रमन्ति च।।10.9।।

translated_text: To those who are ever devoted and worship me with love, I give the yoga of wisdom by which they come to me.
original_text:
तेषां सततयुक्तानां भजतां प्रीतिपूर्वकम्।
ददामि बुद्धियोगं तं येन मामुपयान्ति ते।।10.10।।

translated_text: Out of compassion for them, I dwell in their hearts and destroy the darkness of ignorance with the luminous lamp of knowledge.
original_text:
तेषामेवानुकम्पार्थमहमज्ञानजं तमः।
नाशयाम्यात्मभावस्थो ज्ञानदीपेन भास्करः।।10.11।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: You are the Supreme Brahman, the supreme abode, the most pure, the eternal, divine person, unborn, all-pervading.
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
परं ब्रह्म परं धाम पवित्रं परमं भवान्।
पुरुषं शाश्वतं दिव्यमादिदेवमजं विभुम्।।10.12।।

translated_text: All the sages and divine beings declare you to be the unborn, eternal, supreme refuge. How much more then the humans!
original_text:
आसुर्याः सर्वे देवाः त्वां प्रणम्यान्ति विद्विषः।
किं नु ते नमस्कृत्यासन्नरा इमे नराधमाः।।10.13।।

translated_text: You are the first God, the ancient person, the supreme support of all, the knower, and the master of all.
original_text:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणो विश्वपाश्चिक्षुर्म वर्तसे।
सर्वे देवा त्वमेव प्रभुर्ब्रह्मा सनातनः।।10.14।।

translated_text: I know all beings, past, present, and future, O Arjuna, but none truly know me.
original_text:
वेदाहं समवीतानी वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।
भूतानि भावितानि च भूतं च मदनुग्रहात्।।10.15।।

translated_text: No one truly knows me, O Arjuna. I am known through the Vedas and their study.
original_text:
न हि मां वेद कश्चित्कश्चिद्वेत्ति मामव्ययम्।
अपरं भवतो जन्म पूर्वं च मया श्रुतम्।।10.16।।

translated_text: Those who know me as the supreme person, having realized this knowledge, are devoted to me. They are free from delusion and know the supreme goal.
original_text:
इदं ज्ञानमवाप्य मां परमं वेत्ति भारत।
सर्वज्ञानविभावेन मद्भावेनैव चापरे।।10.17।।

translated_text: I am the source of all, and from me everything emanates. Knowing this, the wise worship me with devotion.
original_text:
अहं सर्वस्य प्रभवो मत्तः सर्वं प्रवर्तते।
इति मत्वा भजन्ते मां बुधा भावसमन्विताः।।10.18।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: I shall declare my principal divine glories. There is no end to their description, O mighty one.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि विभूतीर्याः परम्पराः।
मुख्या मुख्या विभूतयो विद्धि मे भेषजं विभो।।10.19।।

translated_text: I am the Self, O Gudakesha, dwelling in the hearts of all beings. I am the beginning, the middle, and the end of all beings.
original_text:
अहमात्मा गुडाकेशे सर्वभूताशयस्थितः।
अहमादिश्च मध्यं च भूतानामन्त एव च।।10.20।।

translated_text: Among the Adityas, I am Vishnu; among lights, I am the radiant sun; among the Maruts, I am Marichi; among the stars, I am the moon.
original_text:
आदित्यानामहं विष्णुर्ज्योतिषां रविरंशुमान्।
मरुत्चास्मि नक्षत्राणां केशी हास्मि समुद्रमणिः।।10.21।।

translated_text: Among the Vedas, I am the Sama Veda; among the gods, I am Indra; among the senses, I am the mind; among beings, I am consciousness.
original_text:
वेदानां सामवेदोऽस्मि देवानामस्मि वासवः।
इन्द्रियाणां मनश्चास्मि भूतानामस्मि चेतना।।10.22।।

translated_text: Among the Rudras, I am Shankara; among the Yakshas and Rakshasas, I am Kubera; among the Vasus, I am fire; among mountains, I am Meru.
original_text:
रुद्राणां शङ्करश्चास्मि वित्तेशो यक्षरक्षसाम्।
वसूनां पावकश्चास्मि मेरुः शिखरिणामहम्।।10.23।।

translated_text: Among priests, know me to be the chief, Brihaspati; among generals, I am Skanda; among lakes, I am the ocean.
original_text:
पुरोधसां च मुख्यं मां विद्धि पार्थ बृहस्पतिम्।
सेनानीनामहं स्कन्दः सरसामस्मि सागरः।।10.24।।

translated_text: Among the great sages, I am Bhrgu; among vibrations, I am the syllable Om; among sacrifices, I am the chanting of holy names; among immovable things, the Himalayas.
original_text:
महर्षीणां भृगुरहं गिरामस्मि एकमक्षरम्।
यज्ञानां जपयज्ञोऽस्मि स्थावराणां हिमालयः।।10.25।।

translated_text: Among all trees, I am the ashvattha; among the divine sages, Narada; among the Gandharvas, Chitraratha; among the perfected, Kapila the sage.
original_text:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः।।10.26।।

translated_text: Among horses, know me to be Uchchaihshravas, born of the amrita; among elephants, Airavata; among humans, the king.
original_text:
उच्चैःश्रवसं अश्वानां विद्धि माममृतोद्भवम्।
ऐरावतं गजेन्द्राणां नराणां च नराधिपः।।10.27।।

translated_text: Among weapons, I am the thunderbolt; among cows, I am the wish-fulfilling cow (Kamadhuk); among creators, I am Kanda (the progenitor); among serpents, I am Vasuki.
original_text:
आयुधानामहं वज्रं धेनूनामस्मि कामधुक्।
प्रजापतीनां चाहं कन्दः पशूनां मृगश्च श्र्म्हः।।10.28।।

translated_text: Among Nagas, I am Ananta; among aquatic beings, Varuna; among the departed ancestors, I am Aryama; among the controllers, I am Yama.
original_text:
अनन्तश्चास्मि नागानां वरुणो यादसां हि अहम्।
पितृनामर्यमा चास्मि यमः संयमिनां हि अहम्।।10.29।।

translated_text: Among the Daityas, I am Prahlada; among timekeepers, I am Time; among beasts, I am the lion; among birds, I am Garuda (Vainateya).
original_text:
प्रह्लादश्चास्मि दैत्यानां कालः कलयतां हि अहम्।
मृगाणां च मृगेन्द्रोऽहं वैनतेयश्च पक्षिणाम्।।10.30।।

translated_text: Among purifiers, I am the wind; among warriors, I am Rama; among fishes, I am the shark; among streams, I am the Ganges.
original_text:
पवनः पवितराश्चास्मि रामः शस्त्रभृतामहम्।
झषाणां मकरश्चास्मि स्रोतसामस्मि जाह्नवी।।10.31।।

translated_text: Of all creations, I am the beginning, middle, and end, O Arjuna. Of all knowledge, I am the Self-knowledge. Among debaters, I am the conclusive truth.
original_text:
सर्गाणामादिरन्तश्च मध्यं चैवाहमर्जुन।
अध्यात्मविद्या विद्यानां वादः प्रवदतामहम्।।10.32।।

translated_text: Of letters, I am the letter 'A'; among compounds, I am the dual. I am inexhaustible Time. I am the creator whose face is everywhere.
original_text:
अक्षराणामकारोऽस्मि द्वन्द्वः सामासिकानामहम्।
अहमेवाक्षयः कालो धाताहं विश्वतोमुखः।।10.33।।

translated_text: I am all-destroying Time, and also the origin of all that is to come. Among healers, I am the physician. Among the wise, I am their wisdom.
original_text:
मृत्युः सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च विशामपि।
वैद्यानामहं वैद्यः सर्वस्य च हितं वदन्।।10.34।।

translated_text: I am the seed of all beings, O Pritha. I am the intelligence of the intelligent, the brilliance of the brilliant.
original_text:
बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।
बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतामस्मि तेजस्तेजस्विनामहम्।।10.35।।

translated_text: I am the strength of the strong, devoid of desire and attachment. Among all beings, I am desire in accord with dharma, O bull among Bharatas.
original_text:
बलं बलवतां चाहं कामरागविवर्जितम्।
धर्माविरुद्धो भूतेषु कामोऽस्मि भरतर्षभ।।10.36।।

translated_text: Among the Vrishnis, I am Vasudeva; among the Pandavas, Arjuna; among sages, I am Kapila; among horses, I am Uchchaihshravas.
original_text:
वासुदेवोऽहं भूतेषु पाण्डवो धनञ्जयः।
ऋषीणां कपिलोऽहं वृक्षाणां च समीचताम्।।10.37।।

translated_text: Among all trees, I am the ashvattha; among the divine sages, Narada; among the Gandharvas, Chitraratha; among the perfected, Kapila.
original_text:
अश्वत्थः सर्ववृक्षाणां देवर्षीणां च नारदः।
गन्धर्वाणां चित्ररथः सिद्धानां कपिलो मुनिः।।10.38।।

translated_text: All sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic beings are born from me alone. But I am not in them, nor they in me.
original_text:
ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि न त्वहं तेषु वै मयि।।10.39।।

translated_text: I pervade this entire universe in my unmanifest form. All beings are in me, but I am not in them.
original_text:
त्रैलोक्यं च मम तत्त्वं विद्धि चैव पृथिवीश्चराचरम्।
जगदव्यक्तरूपेण मया धार्यते जगत्।।10.40।।

translated_text: With your own eyes, you cannot see me. I give you divine sight. Behold my divine yoga.
original_text:
न तु मां शक्यसे द्रष्टुमनेनैव स्वचक्षुषा।
दिव्यं ददामि ते चक्षुः पश्य मे योगमैश्वरम्।।10.41।।

translated_text: Know that all these universes combined do not contain a fraction of me. I am the source of all manifestation.
original_text:
सहस्रयुगपर्यन्तमहर्यद्ब्रह्मणो विदुः।
रात्रिं युगसहस्रान्तां तेऽहोरात्रविदो जनाः।।10.42।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: By your grace, you have revealed the supreme secret. Through this, my delusion is dispelled.
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
मदनुग्रहाय वचनं त्वदीयं सविस्तरम्।
यदिदं दर्शितं रूपं भवता तदवैम्यहम्।।11.1।।

translated_text: My delusion is destroyed. By your words, I have regained my memory. My doubts have gone. I shall act according to your word.
original_text:
एवमेतद्यथात्थं त्वं मामेव त्वथा मे भवान्।
स योगः स परं तत्त्वं श्रोतुं काङ्क्षामि वेदनम्।।11.2।।

translated_text: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus to Arjuna, Krishna displayed his own divine form to Arjuna.
original_text:
सञ्जय उवाच
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा स्वकं द्युतिम्।
पुनरुवाच महाबाहो हर्षयामास भारतः।।11.3।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: O God, I see in your body all the gods and all the hosts of beings. I see Brahma seated on a lotus, all the sages, and the divine serpents.
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थं ऋषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्।।11.4।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: Behold my cosmic form with hundreds of mouths, blazing like a thousand suns.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सवित्रौकूपितं दृष्ट्वा बाहुदण्डविचारितम्।
इन्द्रं नृत्यति निर्लेखं तत्र शङ्खान्प्रचकार सः।।11.5।।

translated_text: O son of Pandu, all the beings are in your body. The forms of the gods, the divine hosts, and Brahma seated on the lotus — I show you my universal form.
original_text:
अथैनं सम्भवेन तेन सर्वांस्तेन देही तदा।
द्युतिं सर्वस्य लोकस्य विश्वरूपं स दर्शयन्।।11.6।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: I see the divine form of yours, O Krishna, with many arms, bellies, mouths, and eyes, spread everywhere. I see no beginning, middle, or end of you.
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
सर्वेषां भवतो रूपं दैवं विश्वमवस्थितम्।
पश्यामि गोविन्दासीनं सर्वेषां भवतोऽव्ययम्।।11.7।।

translated_text: With my own eyes, I see the cosmic form of yours, adorned with many crowns, holding many weapons, full of brilliance, blazing all around like a thousand suns.
original_text:
न हि पश्यामि सम्बन्धं केशवास्य स्थितस्य ते।
किरीटिनं गदिनं चक्रिणं च तेजोरशिं सर्वतो दीप्तिमन्तम्।।11.8।।

translated_text: If the light of a thousand suns were to blaze forth all at once in the sky, it might resemble the splendor of that great being.
original_text:
दिवि सूर्यसहस्रस्य भवेद्युगपद्युता।
भासो यस्यासां महत्सहस्राधिकम्।।11.9।।

translated_text: Arjuna, the son of Pandu, then saw the entire universe, with its manifold divisions and forms, united in the body of the God of gods.
original_text:
तदा तत्सैन्यं हरिः सर्वभूतानि तदा।
तत्सैन्यं दृष्टवानर्जुनस्तदा च देहिनाम्।।11.10।।

translated_text: There in the body of the God of gods, Arjuna saw the entire universe, with all its manifold divisions and forms united as one.
original_text:
तत्रैकस्थं ददर्श विश्वरूपं वैश्वानरम्।
दारिद्रयं ददर्श तत्र शतभाहो महाबाहो।।11.11।।

translated_text: If the effulgence of a thousand suns were to blaze forth at once in the sky, it might resemble the splendor of that great being.
original_text:
यदि सूर्यसहस्रस्य एकं युगपद्युता।
भासो यस्यासां महत्सहस्राधिकम्।।11.12।।

translated_text: Then, overwhelmed with wonder, with hair standing on end, Arjuna bowed his head to the Lord and spoke with joined palms.
original_text:
तदा स विस्मितो भूत्वा रोमहर्षं जगाम ह।
हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।।11.13।।

translated_text: I see all the gods, O God, and the various hosts of beings. I see Brahma seated on the lotus, all the sages, and the divine serpents.
original_text:
पश्यामि देवांस्तव देव देहे सर्वांस्तथा भूतविशेषसङ्घान्।
ब्रह्माणमीशं कमलासनस्थं ऋषींश्च सर्वानुरगांश्च दिव्यान्।।11.14।।

translated_text: I see your form, O great one, with many mouths and eyes, many arms, thighs, and feet, and many bellies. I see the universe in you, O Lord of marvelous form.
original_text:
रूपं महत्ते बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं महाबाहो बहुबाहूरुपादम्।
पश्यामि विश्वं विविधान्निभं त्वं नानारूपाणि नरत्विनानि।।11.15।।

translated_text: I see you with a thousand crowns, the universal Self, with a thousand arms, all forms and bellies, thousand feet, thousand eyes — illuminating the three worlds with your brilliance.
original_text:
सहस्रचूदं विश्वात्मं सहस्रबाहुं भवतं सर्वं।
सहस्रपदं सहस्रनेत्रं त्रिलोक्यं दर्शितं स्वतेजसा।।11.16।।

translated_text: I see you with a thousand crowns, universal Self, with a thousand arms, all forms, thousand feet, thousand eyes — illuminating the three worlds.
original_text:
सहस्रचूदं विश्वात्मं सहस्रबाहुं भवतं सर्वम्।
सहस्रपदं सहस्रनेत्रं त्रिलोक्यं दर्शितं स्वतेजसा।।11.17।।

translated_text: I am time, the great destroyer of the world. Even without you, none of the warriors arrayed against these armies shall survive.
original_text:
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः।।11.18।।

translated_text: Therefore, arise and gain glory. Conquer your enemies and enjoy the kingdom. They have already been slain by me. You are merely the instrument, O Savyasachin.
original_text:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व जित्वा शत्रून्भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्।।11.19।।

translated_text: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna, and all the other warriors — they are already slain by me. You are merely the instrument.
original_text:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च कर्णं तथान्यान्पि योधान्विद्धि।
मयैवैतान्निहतान्पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्।।11.20।।

translated_text: What need is there for this battle? I have done nothing and shall do nothing. What benefit do I seek? All these warriors are already slain by you.
original_text:
किं नु मे कश्मलं कृष्ण त्वदर्थे कृतवेश्यताम्।
मया न हि कश्चित्पापं कृतमविद्धः।।11.21।।

translated_text: Therefore, whoever worships me with devotion, I regard as most dear to me. There is no distinction among my devotees.
original_text:
तस्माद्यो यो मां भजति केशवं भक्तिमन्वितम्।
स मे प्रीततमो मन्ये न हि तेषां विशेषोऽस्ति मे।।11.22।।

translated_text: When one sees the whole universe as one in Brahman, then one sees through the wisdom of the Self.
original_text:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्यच्य पश्यति।।11.23।।

translated_text: When one sees the entire universe of beings as one in Brahman, one sees the self clearly.
original_text:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्यच्य पश्यति।।11.24।।

translated_text: When one sees all beings as one in Brahman, one attains the supreme vision.
original_text:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्यच्य पश्यति।।11.25।।

translated_text: See all the gods, O Arjuna, stationed within my body. Bhishma, Drona, Somadatta, Jayadratha — all the warriors.
original_text:
पश्य मे पार्थ देवेशान्सर्वांस्तवान्तरे स्थितान्।
भीष्मद्रोणं तथा सोमदत्तं जयद्रथं तथा।।11.26।।

translated_text: All these warriors, your kinsmen, sons, brothers, friends, and relatives — all of them are rushing into your mouths.
original_text:
योधावन्तः सर्व एवे तवैव भ्रातृपुत्रा भृत्यश्च वृद्धाः।
सर्वे भ्रातृपुत्राः भृत्यवृद्धाः योधावन्तो मदर्थं त्वत्पराः।।11.27।।

translated_text: As the many rushing torrents of rivers flow toward the ocean, so do these heroes of the human world rush into your blazing mouths.
original_text:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविद्विषन्तः।।11.28।।

translated_text: As the many rivers flow toward the ocean, so do these warriors rush into your mouths, O Lord.
original_text:
यथा नदीनां बहवोऽम्बुवेगाः समुद्रमेवाभिमुखा द्रवन्ति।
तथा तवामी नरलोकवीरा विशन्ति वक्त्राण्यभिविद्विषन्तः।।11.29।।

translated_text: As a blazing fire reduces wood to ashes, O Arjuna, so does the fire of knowledge reduce all karma to ashes.
original_text:
यथा पवको भस्मसात्कुरुतेऽर्जुन।
ज्ञानाग्निः सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा।।11.30।।

translated_text: You are the supreme goal. I do not know your true nature. I wish to know you as you truly are.
original_text:
स्वर्गापवर्गं त्वस्मिन् दर्शितम्।
न वेत्थ मां विश्वरूपं त्वम्।।11.31।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: I am time, the great destroyer of the world. Even without you, none of these warriors arrayed against these armies shall survive.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।
ऋतेऽपि त्वां न भविष्यन्ति सर्वे येऽवस्थिताः प्रत्यनीकेषु योधाः।।11.32।।

translated_text: Therefore, arise and gain glory. Conquer your enemies and enjoy the kingdom. They are already slain by me. You are merely the instrument, O Savyasachin.
original_text:
तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ यशो लभस्व जित्वा शत्रून्भुङ्क्ष्व राज्यं समृद्धम्।
मयैवैते निहताः पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्।।11.33।।

translated_text: Drona, Bhishma, Jayadratha, Karna — all the other warriors are already slain by me. You are merely the instrument.
original_text:
द्रोणं च भीष्मं च जयद्रथं च कर्णं तथान्यान्पि योधान्विद्धि।
मयैवैतान्निहतान्पूर्वमेव निमित्तमात्रं भव सव्यसाचिन्।।11.34।।

translated_text: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus, Krishna displayed his own divine form to Arjuna again. Arjuna was filled with wonder.
original_text:
सञ्जय उवाच
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा स्वकं द्युतिम्।
पुनरुवाच महाबाहो हर्षयामास भारतः।।11.35।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: Rightly, O Hrishikesha, by your glory, the world is delighted and rejoices. The demons flee in all directions. All the hosts of sages bow to you.
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या जगत्प्रहृत्या च विश्वमादितम्।
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।।11.36।।

translated_text: O great one, who should not bow to you? You are greater than Brahma. You are the original creator. You are the supreme Lord of all worlds.
original_text:
कस्माच्च ते न नमेरन्महात्मन् गरीयसे ब्रह्मणोऽपि अधिपते।
अनन्त देवोत्तम लोकनाथ तस्मात्प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय चाहम्।।11.37।।

translated_text: You are the first God, the ancient person, the supreme support of all, the knower, and the master of all.
original_text:
त्वमादिदेवः पुरुषः पुराणो विश्वपाश्चिक्षुर्म वर्तसे।
सर्वे देवा त्वमेव प्रभुर्ब्रह्मा सनातनः।।11.38।।

translated_text: You are Vayu, Yama, Agni, Varuna, the moon, the creator, and the father of all. I bow to you again and again.
original_text:
वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः शशाङ्कः प्रजापतिस्त्वं प्रणिपाश्च मारीचिः।
सुरासुराः सिद्धाः संघास्तवैवास्मि विद्धि सर्वान्सर्वशः।।11.39।।

translated_text: I bow to you thousands of times. Salutations, salutations to you, again and again.
original_text:
पूर्वं ह्यसि भविष्याश्च देवानां त्वमव्ययः।
महर्षीणां च सर्वेषां नमस्ते अस्तु साहस्रशः।
पुनश्च भूयोऽपि नमो नमस्ते अस्तु सहस्रशः।
नमो नमस्ते अस्तु सहस्रशः।।11.40।।

translated_text: Thus addressed by Arjuna, Krishna placed the best of chariots between the two armies.
original_text:
हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।
सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये स्थापयित्वा रथोत्तमम्।।11.41।।

translated_text: Overwhelmed with wonder, hair standing on end, Arjuna bowed his head and spoke to Krishna.
original_text:
तदा स विस्मितो भूत्वा रोमहर्षं जगाम ह।
हृषीकेशं तदा वाक्यमिदमाह महीपते।।11.42।।

translated_text: By your glory, the world rejoices. All beings are delighted and dance with joy, O Lord.
original_text:
स्थाने हृषीकेश तव प्रकीर्त्या जगत्प्रहृत्या च विश्वमादितम्।
कालोऽस्मि लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह प्रवृत्तः।।11.43।।

translated_text: All the gods bow to you. How much more I! I bow to you, O Lord of lords, O friend of the world.
original_text:
सर्वे देवा त्वमेव प्रभुर्ब्रह्मा सनातनः।
सर्वे देवा नमस्यन्ति तस्मात्त्वं प्रणम्य प्रणिधाय चाहम्।।11.44।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: I spoke to you, calling you friend, because I was unaware. I was proud, thinking you were just my friend.
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
सखेति मत्वा प्रसभं यदुक्तं हे कृष्ण हे यादव हे सखेति।
अज्ञानेनावृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः।।11.45।।

translated_text: I did not know your universal form.
original_text: न वेत्थ मां विश्वरूपं त्वम्।।11.46।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: Out of compassion for you, I have shown you this supreme, most secret form. By my yoga-maya, my real form cannot be seen.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
मदनुग्रहाय परमं गुह्यमध्यात्मं सम्भितम्।
प्रोक्तवानहमव्ययं विवस्वते।।11.47।।

translated_text: No one can see this form of mine as you have seen it, except by you. Neither through the Vedas, nor through austerity, nor through charity, nor through sacrifice.
original_text:
न रूपमस्य ते त्यज्यं नान्तरं बाह्यं वा हि तत्।
दृष्टं त्वा ज्ञानचक्षुर्मया दत्तं तवाश्रितम्।।11.48।।

translated_text: Do not grieve. Be happy. Having attained me through yoga, you will attain liberation.
original_text:
मा शुचः सुखी भव योगं समासाद्य मां च।
स योगो भविता निश्चितं वेत्तुमर्हसि।।11.49।।

translated_text: Sanjaya said: Having spoken thus, Krishna showed his gentle form again. Arjuna was filled with great joy.
original_text:
सञ्जय उवाच
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा स्वकं द्युतिम्।
पुनरुवाच महाबाहो हर्षयामास भारतः।।11.50।।

translated_text: Krishna said: With this form of mine, you were terrified. Now, having seen my gentle form, be at peace.
original_text:
कृष्ण उवाच
सुखं मन्ये महाबाहो दृष्ट्वेदं रूपं शान्तिरस्तु वै।
पुनरुवाच महाबाहो हर्षयामास भारतः।।11.51।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: This form of mine which you have seen is very rare to see. Even the gods are always desirous of seeing it.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः।।11.52।।

translated_text: I cannot be seen as you have seen me through the Vedas, austerity, charity, or sacrifice. Only through exclusive devotion can I be known and seen.
original_text:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा।।11.53।।

translated_text: Through exclusive devotion, O Arjuna, I can be known, seen in truth, and entered into.
original_text:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परन्तप।।11.54।।

translated_text: One who does actions for me, who considers me the supreme, who is my devotee, free from attachment and enmity toward all beings, comes to me, O Arjuna.
original_text:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः।
विरक्तो भूतदोषैर्मे समो भूत्सु चार्जुन।।11.55।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: Those who are ever devoted to you and those who worship the imperishable and unmanifest — which of them are better knowers of yoga?
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
एवं सततयुक्ता ये भक्तास्त्वां पर्युपासते।
ये चाप्यक्षरमव्यक्तं तेषां के योगवित्तमाः।।12.1।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: Those who fix their minds on me, ever devoted, endowed with supreme faith — they are the most perfect in yoga.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
मय्यावेश्य मनो ये मां नित्ययुक्ता उपासते।
श्रद्धया परयोपेतास्ते मे युक्ततमा मताः।।12.2।।

translated_text: But those who worship the imperishable, the undefinable, the unmanifest, omnipresent, inconceivable, immovable, eternal.
original_text:
ये त्वक्षरमनिर्देश्यमव्यक्तं पर्युपासते।
सर्वत्र्यगमचिन्त्यं च कूटस्थमचलं ध्रुवम्।।12.3।।

translated_text: Restraining all senses, equal-visioned toward all beings, devoted to the welfare of all — they come to me.
original_text:
संनियम्येन्द्रियग्रामं सर्वत्र समबुद्धयः।
ते प्राप्नुवन्ति मामेव सर्वभूतहिते रताः।।12.4।।

translated_text: Greater is the difficulty for those whose minds are attached to the unmanifest. The path to the unmanifest is difficult for embodied beings to reach.
original_text:
क्लेशोऽधिकतरस्तेषामव्यक्तासक्तचेतसाम्।
अव्यक्ता हि गतिर्दुःखं देहवद्भिरवाप्यते।।12.5।।

translated_text: But those who, dedicating all actions to me, with me as their supreme goal, worship me through single-pointed yoga.
original_text:
ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्पराः।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते।।12.6।।

translated_text: For those whose minds are fixed on me, I become the savior from the ocean of death and rebirth. Quickly.
original_text:
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।
भवामि नचिरात्पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम्।।12.7।।

translated_text: Fix your mind on me alone. Fix your intellect in me. Thus you will live in me alone. There is no doubt.
original_text:
मय्येव मन आधध्य मयि बुद्धिं निवेशय।
निवसिष्यसि मय्येव अत ऊर्ध्वं न संशयः।।12.8।।

translated_text: If you cannot fix your mind steadily on me, O Dhananjaya, then practice yoga to reach me.
original_text:
अथ चित्तं समाधातुं न शक्नोषि मयि स्थितम्।
अभ्यासयोगेन ततो मामिच्छाप्तुं धनञ्जय।।12.9।।

translated_text: If you are unable to practice even this, devote yourself to action for my sake. Even action performed for my sake is perfect.
original_text:
अभ्यासेऽप्यसमर्थोऽसि मत्कर्मपरमो भव।
मदर्थं कर्म कौन्तेय मुक्तसङ्गः समाचर।।12.10।।

translated_text: If you are unable even to practice this, then, taking refuge in me, renounce all the fruits of action. Be self-disciplined.
original_text:
अथैतदप्यशक्तोऽसि कर्तुं मद्योगमाश्रितः।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं ततः कुरु यतात्मवान्।।12.11।।

translated_text: Better than mere practice is knowledge. Better than knowledge is meditation. Better than meditation is the renunciation of the fruits of action. From renunciation comes peace.
original_text:
श्रेयो हि ज्ञानमभ्यासाज्ज्ञानाद्ध्यानं विशिष्यते।
ध्यानात्कर्मफलत्यागस्त्यागाच्छान्तिरनन्तरम्।।12.12।।

translated_text: One who is not a hater of any being, who is friendly and compassionate, free from possessiveness and ego, the same in pleasure and pain, and forgiving.
original_text:
अद्वेष्टा सर्वभूतानां मैत्रः करुण एव च।
निर्ममो निरहङ्कारः समदुःखसुखः क्षमी।।12.13।।

translated_text: Content with what comes by chance, free from the pairs of opposites, established in the self, such a person is not bound even when acting.
original_text:
सन्तुष्टस्तत्कतेन चित्तमात्मनि निवेशितः।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते।।12.14।।

translated_text: One from whom the world does not turn away, and who does not turn away from the world — freed from joy, anger, fear, and anxiety — such a one is dear to me.
original_text:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः।।12.15।।

translated_text: Free from expectations, pure, skillful, unconcerned, free from worry, who has abandoned all projects — such a devotee is dear to me.
original_text:
अनपेक्षः शुचिर्दक्ष उदासीनो गतव्यथः।
सर्वारम्भपरित्यागी यो मे भक्तः स मे प्रियः।।12.16।।

translated_text: One who neither rejoices nor hates, neither grieves nor desires, who has abandoned good and evil results, such a devotee is dear to me.
original_text:
यो न हृष्यति न द्वेष्टि न शोचति न काङ्क्षति।
शुभाशुभपरित्यागी भक्तिमान्यः स मे प्रियः।।12.17।।

translated_text: Equal to friend and foe, the same in honor and dishonor, in cold and heat, pleasure and pain, free from attachment.
original_text:
समः शत्रौ च मित्रे च तथा मानापमानयोः।
शीतोष्णसुखदुःखेषु समः सङ्गविवर्जितः।।12.18।।

translated_text: Who regards blame and praise as the same, who is silent, content with anything, who has no fixed home, steady-minded, full of devotion — such a person is dear to me.
original_text:
तुल्यनिन्दास्तुतिर्मौनी सन्तुष्टो येन केनचित्।
अनिकेतः स्थिरमतिर्भक्तिमान्मे प्रियो नरः।।12.19।।

translated_text: Those who follow this immortal dharma as declared, with faith, regarding me as supreme — those devoted people are very dear to me.
original_text:
ये तु धर्म्यामृतमिदं यथोक्तं पर्युपासते।
श्रद्धाना मत्पराः ते मद्भावायोपापन्नाः।।12.20।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: This body, O son of Kunti, is called the field. One who knows it is called the knower of the field by the wise.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
इदं शरीरं कौन्तेय क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।
एतद्यो वेत्ति तं प्राहुः क्षेत्रज्ञ इति तद्विदः।।13.1।।

translated_text: Know me also as the knower of the field in all fields, O Bharata. Knowledge of the field and the knower of the field — this knowledge is considered by me to be true knowledge.
original_text:
क्षेत्रज्ञं चापि मां विद्धि सर्वक्षेत्रेषु भारत।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम।।13.2।।

translated_text: What that field is, what its nature is, what its modifications are, and from what it arises, and who that knower is — hear this from me briefly.
original_text:
तत्क्षेत्रं यच्च यावद्यत् तच्च यद्विशेषतः।
कारणं च प्रवृत्तिश्च क्षेत्रमित्यभिधीयते।।13.3।।

translated_text: The great sages have sung in various ways, with clear verses and reasoning, about the cause, the nature of the field, and its modifications.
original_text:
ऋषिभिर्बहुशो गीतं चरित्रं चैव चार्जुन।
कारणं चैव च क्षेत्रं क्षेत्रेषु च विशेषतः।।13.4।।

translated_text: The great elements, ego, intellect, and prakriti — making ten — along with the five sense objects, and the five sense organs.
original_text:
महाभूतान्यहङ्कारो बुद्धिर्मे प्रकृतिर्दश।
पञ्च तैरिन्द्रियाणि च शब्दादीनीन्द्रियाणि च।।13.5।।

translated_text: Desire, hatred, pleasure, pain, the aggregate, consciousness, and fortitude — this field, along with its modifications, has been briefly described.
original_text:
इ�्छा द्वेषः सुखं दुःखं संघातश्चेतना धृतिः।
एतत्क्षेत्रं समासेन सविकारमुदाहृतम्।।13.6।।

translated_text: Humility, non-pride, non-violence, forgiveness, uprightness, devotion to the teacher, purity, steadfastness, self-control.
original_text:
अमानित्वमदम्भित्वमहिंसा क्षान्तिरार्जवम्।
आचार्योपासनं शौचं स्थैर्यमात्मविनिग्रहः।।13.7।।

translated_text: Indifference to objects of sense, absence of ego, discernment of the pain and evil of birth, death, old age, and disease.
original_text:
अभिमानोऽवमानश्च मोहो निर्विषयः स्मृतिः।
शास्त्रं तत्त्वं विज्ञानं विपश्चित्स्यादसंशयम्।।13.8।।

translated_text: Non-duality, the absence of attachment, perception of the evil of birth, death, old age, and disease, and non-attachment to sons, wife, home, etc.
original_text:
अद्वन्द्वो भूतदोषानां विविक्तिः परमात्मनः।
विशेषं वेदविदुश्च क्षेत्रज्ञज्ञाननिश्चयम्।।13.9।।

translated_text: Unwavering faith, non-attachment to worldly things, and constant meditation on the supreme. The vision of the difference between the field and the knower of the field is knowledge.
original_text:
आशापरितिष्ठा देशान्तरानर्थविग्रहः।
अनन्यचेता हि मम चित्तं सर्वान्कर्मसंन्यासिनाम्।।13.10।।

translated_text: Knowledge of the field, the knower of the field, and the distinction between them — this is true knowledge.
original_text:
ज्ञानं प्रत्यवित्थानं विज्ञानं यच्छ पश्यति।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञयोर्ज्ञानं यत्तज्ज्ञानं मतं मम।।13.11।।

translated_text: Know that prakriti and purusha are beginningless. Their modifications and the causes are from the gunas.
original_text:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्धि यनादि उभौ च।
कारणं गुणसंयोगात्तद्यथावच्च वार्ता।।13.12।।

translated_text: Prakriti produces all effects, but the Self is the cause of the experiences of pleasure and pain. The embodied being transmigrates through the cycle of birth and death, driven by karma.
original_text:
प्रकृतिकार्यकर्तारि कर्मणि प्रविहिताः स्वयम्।
संसारं चरति प्राणी गतागतं कर्मवशात्।।13.13।।

translated_text: The Self, though subtle, all-pervading, the witness, knower of all, the source of all knowledge, and beyond prakriti — know it thus.
original_text:
सूक्ष्मत्वात्सर्वदर्शी सर्ववेदान्तविद् यतः।
सर्वज्ञानविभावेन मद्भावेनैव चापरे।।13.14।।

translated_text: Not manifest to all, being veiled by my yoga-maya, this foolish world does not know me as unborn and imperishable.
original_text:
अव्यक्तं व्यक्तिमापन्नं मन्यन्ते मामबुद्धयः।
परं भावमजानन्तो ममाव्ययमनुत्तमम्।।13.15।।

translated_text: I know all beings, past, present, and future, O Arjuna, but none truly know me.
original_text:
वेदाहं समवीतानी वर्तमानानि चार्जुन।
भूतानि भावितानि च भूतं च मदनुग्रहात्।।13.16।।

translated_text: No one truly knows me, O Arjuna. I am known through the Vedas and their study.
original_text:
न हि मां वेद कश्चित्कश्चिद्वेत्ति मामव्ययम्।
अपरं भवतो जन्म पूर्वं च मया श्रुतम्।।13.17।।

translated_text: Those who know me as the supreme person, having realized this knowledge, are devoted to me.
original_text:
इदं ज्ञानमवाप्य मां परमं वेत्ति भारत।
सर्वज्ञानविभावेन मद्भावेनैव चापरे।।13.18।।

translated_text: Know that prakriti and purusha are both beginningless. Their modifications and causes arise from the gunas.
original_text:
प्रकृतिं पुरुषं चैव विद्धि यनादि उभौ च।
कारणं गुणसंयोगात्तद्यथावच्च वार्ता।।13.19।।

translated_text: Prakriti is the cause of the physical manifestation. The Self causes the experience of pleasure and pain. The embodied being transmigrates through the cycle driven by karma.
original_text:
प्रकृतिः कर्मकर्तारि कर्मणि प्रविहिता स्वयम्।
संसारं चरति प्राणी गतागतं कर्मवशात्।।13.20।।

translated_text: The Self, being in prakriti, experiences the gunas born of prakriti. Attachment to them causes the good and evil births.
original_text:
कर्मचोदकः पुमान् नैव कर्मसंस्कृतः।
न कर्मफलसंयोगं विद्धि विविदिषय विनिर्मुक्तो भव।।13.21।।

translated_text: The supreme Self is the witness, the approver, the supporter, the enjoyer, the supreme Lord, and the Self within the body.
original_text:
उपद्रष्टानुमन्ता च भर्ता भोक्ता महेश्वरः।
परमात्मेति चाप्युक्तो देहेऽस्मिन्पुरुषः परः।।13.22।।

translated_text: One who truly knows the Self and prakriti with its gunas — in whatever way they act, they are never bound.
original_text:
य एवं वेत्ति पुरुषं प्रकृतिं च गुणैः सह।
सर्वथा वर्तमानोऽपि न स बध्यो भवत्युत।।13.23।।

translated_text: Some see the self through meditation; others through the yoga of knowledge; and others through the yoga of action.
original_text:
ध्यानेनात्मनि पश्यन्ति केचिदात्मानमात्मना।
अन्ये साङ्ख्येन योगेन कर्मयोगेन चापरे।।13.24।।

translated_text: But others, not knowing this, devoted to hearing, perish. They are lost through the wrong path.
original_text:
अन्ये तु तदविद्यात्यज्ञानं स्मृतं मे धृतं।
ते शृण्वन्ति न विद्धि नावशिष्यते।।13.25।।

translated_text: Know that everything that is born, movable or immovable, is born of the union of the field and the knower of the field, O best of Bharatas.
original_text:
यावत्संजायते किंचित्सत्त्वं स्थावरजङ्गमम्।
क्षेत्रक्षेत्रज्ञसंयोगात्तद्विद्धि भरतर्षभ।।13.26।।

translated_text: One who sees the supreme Lord dwelling equally in all beings, the imperishable within the perishable — that person truly sees.
original_text:
समं सर्वेषु भूतेषु तिष्ठन्तं परमेश्वरम्।
विनश्यत्स्वविनश्यन्तं यः पश्यति स पश्यति।।13.27।।

translated_text: Seeing the Lord dwelling equally everywhere, one does not destroy the self by the self and attains the supreme goal.
original_text:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्।।13.28।।

translated_text: When one sees that all actions are performed by prakriti alone, and the Self does nothing, O mighty-armed one, one sees truly.
original_text:
प्रकृत्यैव च कर्माणि कृतानि ज्ञानदीपिता।
तत्त्ववित्तु महाबाहो तद्विधाहमकर्तव्यताम्।।13.29।।

translated_text: When one sees the diversity of beings as resting in one, and their emanation from Brahman alone, then one attains Brahman.
original_text:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्यच्य पश्यति।।13.30।।

translated_text: The Self, though not manifest, is pervading everything. It is the Lord of all, the knower of all, the controller of all. It dwells within all beings.
original_text:
अद्भूतं सर्वमिदं वैश्वानरं सर्वज्ञं सर्वकर्मकृत्।
यो भूतेषु निवेशात्मा यो भूतेषु चावस्थितः।।13.31।।

translated_text: One who sees that the Self dwells in all beings, and all beings in the Self, sees truly.
original_text:
यो भूतस्थो भूतेशो भूतात्मा भूतभावनः।
तत्सर्वेषु भूतेषु ते सर्वमिदं पश्यति।।13.32।।

translated_text: One who sees the Self in all beings and all beings in the Self — when one sees this, then what delusion and sorrow can there be?
original_text:
यस्मान्नोद्विजते लोको लोकान्नोद्विजते च यः।
हर्षामर्षभयोद्वेगैर्मुक्तो यः स च मे प्रियः।।13.33।।

translated_text: Seeing the Lord dwelling equally everywhere, the self-controlled yogi attains the supreme goal.
original_text:
समं पश्यन्हि सर्वत्र समवस्थितमीश्वरम्।
न हिनस्त्यात्मनात्मानं ततो याति परां गतिम्।।13.34।।

translated_text: Those whose wisdom is covered by ignorance, they are deluded. But those who take refuge in me, whose knowledge is purified — they go beyond death.
original_text:
योऽविद्ययाऽवृतं ज्ञानं तेन मुह्यन्ति जन्तवः।
यो मामेव प्रपद्यन्ते ज्ञानविभवशुद्धये।।13.35।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: Again I shall declare the most supreme knowledge, knowing which all the sages have attained perfection.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
परं भूयः प्रवक्ष्यामि ज्ञानानां ज्ञानमुत्तमम्।
यज्ज्ञात्वा विश्वरूपविद्विष्णोः सुखं लभते।।14.1।।

translated_text: Having known this knowledge, one attains union with me. There is no other path to union with me.
original_text:
इदं ज्ञानमवाप्य मां परमं वेत्ति भारत।
सर्वज्ञानविभावेन मद्भावेनैव चापरे।।14.2।।

translated_text: Whoever knows my divine birth and action, having abandoned the body, is not born again; he comes to me, O Arjuna.
original_text:
जन्म कर्म च मे दिव्यमेवं यो वेत्ति तत्त्वतः।
त्यक्त्वा देहं पुनर्जन्म नैति मामेति सोऽर्जुन।।14.3।।

translated_text: Many, freed from attachment, fear, and anger, absorbed in me, purified by the fire of knowledge, have attained my being.
original_text:
वीतरागभयक्रोधा मन्मया मामुपाश्रिताः।
बहवो ज्ञानतपसा पूता मद्भावमागताः।।14.4।।

translated_text: This entire world is deluded by the three gunas, born of prakriti, and does not know me, who am beyond them and imperishable.
original_text:
त्रिभिर्गुणमयैर्भावैरेभिः सर्वमिदं जगत्।
मोहितं नाभिजानाति मामेभ्यः परमव्ययम्।।14.5।।

translated_text: O best of Bharatas, sattva is illuminating, activating, and pure. It binds through happiness and through the knowledge of joy.
original_text:
सत्त्वं प्रकाशकर्म च ज्ञानं च भरतर्षभ।
लघुत्वं चारोग्यं च सुखं सत्त्वप्रकृतेः प्रभवे।।14.6।।

translated_text: Know rajas to be of the nature of passion — born of desire and attachment. It binds the embodied one through attachment to action.
original_text:
रजो रागात्मकं विद्धि तृष्णासङ्गसमुद्भवम्।
तन्निबध्नाति कौन्तेय कर्मसङ्गेन देहिनम्।।14.7।।

translated_text: Know tamas to be born of ignorance, deluding all beings. It binds through negligence, laziness, and sleep, O Bharata.
original_text:
तमस्तु अज्ञानजं विद्धि मोहनं सर्वदेहिनाम्।
प्रमादालस्यनिद्राभिस्तन्निबध्नाति भारत।।14.8।।

translated_text: Sattva binds through happiness, rajas through action, and tamas, covering wisdom, through negligence.
original_text:
सत्त्वं सुखे सञ्जयति रजः कर्मणि भारत।
ज्ञानमावृत्य तु तमः प्रमादे सञ्जयत्युत।।14.9।।

translated_text: Sometimes sattva prevails over rajas and tamas; sometimes rajas over sattva and tamas; and sometimes tamas over sattva and rajas.
original_text:
रजस्तमश्चाभिभूय सत्त्वं भवति भारत।
ज्ञानं प्रकाशकर्म च कर्म चोभयं मिथः।।14.10।।

translated_text: When through all the gates of the body the light of wisdom shines, one should know that sattva is predominant.
original_text:
सर्वद्वारेषु देहेऽस्मिन्प्रकाश उपजायते।
ज्ञानं यदा तदा विद्याद्विवृद्धिं सत्त्वस्य तत्।।14.11।।

translated_text: Greed, activity, undertaking of actions, restlessness, and desire — these arise when rajas is predominant, O best of Bharatas.
original_text:
लोभः प्रवृत्तिरारम्भः कर्मणामश्रमः स्पृहा।
रजस्येतानि जायन्ते विवृद्धे भरतर्षभ।।14.12।।

translated_text: Negligence, delusion, and ignorance — these arise when tamas is predominant.
original_text:
प्रमादमोहौ तमसो भवतोऽज्ञानमेव च।
प्रमादो मोह एव च तमसो वृद्धिरिष्यते।।14.13।।

translated_text: When the embodied being dies in sattva, it goes to the higher worlds known to those who know the Self.
original_text:
यदा सत्त्वे प्रवृद्धे तु प्रलयं याति देहभृत्।
तदोत्तमविदां लोकाननाद्यान्निब्रच्छति।।14.14।।

translated_text: I am all-destroying Time, and also the origin of all that is to come. Among healers, I am the physician. Among the wise, I am their wisdom.
original_text:
मृत्युं सर्वहरश्चाहमुद्भवश्च विशामपि।
वैद्यानामहं वैद्यः सर्वस्य च हितं वदन्।।14.15।।

translated_text: One must understand what is action, what is wrong action, and what is inaction. The nature of action is profound.
original_text:
कर्मणो ह्यपि बोद्धव्यं बोद्धव्यं च विकर्मणः।
अकर्मणश्च बोद्धव्यं गहना कर्मणो गतिः।।14.16।।

translated_text: One who sees inaction in action and action in inaction is wise among humans, a true yogi, and a performer of all actions.
original_text:
कर्मण्यकर्म यः पश्येदकर्मणि च कर्म यः।
स बुद्धिमान्मनुष्येषु स युक्तः कृत्स्नकर्मकृत्।।14.17।।

translated_text: One whose every undertaking is free from desire, whose actions are burned by the fire of knowledge — the wise call that person a sage.
original_text:
यस्य सर्वे समारम्भाः कामसङ्कल्पवर्जिताः।
ज्ञानाग्निदग्धकर्माणं तमाहुः पण्डितं बुधाः।।14.18।।

translated_text: Having abandoned attachment to the fruits of action, ever content, without dependence, though engaged in action, one does nothing.
original_text:
त्यक्त्वा कर्मफलासङ्गं नित्यतृप्तो निराश्रयः।
कर्मण्यभिप्रवृत्तोऽपि नैव किञ्चित्करोति सः।।14.19।।

translated_text: Without desire, free from thought, without ego, such a person, though performing action, performs it as if through renunciation.
original_text:
निराशीर्निष्चिन्तो भूत्वा निर्ग्रन्थो निरहङ्कृतः।
सन्न्यासकल्पितं कर्म स कर्मात्मनि कुर्वते।।14.20।।

translated_text: Content with what comes by chance, free from the pairs of opposites, established in the self, such a person is not bound even when acting.
original_text:
सन्तुष्टस्तत्कतेन चित्तमात्मनि निवेशितः।
आत्मन्येवात्मना तुष्टस्तस्य कार्यं न विद्यते।।14.21।।

translated_text: When one sees the whole universe as one in Brahman, then one sees through the wisdom of the Self.
original_text:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्यच्य पश्यति।।14.22।।

translated_text: When one sees all beings as resting in Brahman, one attains the supreme vision.
original_text:
यदा भूतपृथग्भावमेकस्थमनुपश्यति।
तत एव च विस्तारं ब्रह्म सम्यच्य पश्यति।।14.23।।

translated_text: One free from ego, whose wisdom is not tainted, even though killing these beings, neither kills nor is bound.
original_text:
यस्य नाहंकृतो भावो बुद्धिर्यस्य न लिप्यते।
हत्वाऽपि स इमान्लोकान्न हन्ति न निबध्यते।।14.24।।

translated_text: The fire of knowledge burns all karma to ashes. Know me thus. That yogi is truly united.
original_text:
ज्ञानाग्निर्दग्धकर्माणं सर्वकर्माणि भस्मसात्कुरुते तथा।
तत्त्वविद्द्धि यो मां स युक्त एवमुच्यते।।14.25।।

translated_text: One who is devoted to me, worships me, and bows to me — that person, being united, attains me.
original_text:
मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।14.26।।

translated_text: Fix your mind on me, be devoted to me, sacrifice to me, bow down to me. Thus united with me and set on me, you will come to me.
original_text:
मन्मना भव मद्भक्तो मद्याजी मां नमस्कुरु।
मामेवैष्यसि सत्यं ते प्रतिजाने प्रियोऽसि मे।।14.27।।

translated_text: They speak of the eternal Ashvattha tree with roots above and branches below, whose leaves are the Vedic hymns. One who knows it is a knower of the Vedas.
original_text:
ऊर्ध्वमूलमधःशाखमश्वत्थं प्राहुरव्ययम्।
छन्दांसि यस्य पर्णानि यस्तं वेद स वेदवित्।।15.1।।

translated_text: Its roots are above and its branches below. Its roots are sustained by the three gunas; its sense-objects are its buds. Its true form is not perceived in this world.
original_text:
ऊर्ध्वमूलोऽवशाखोऽस्य वृक्षस्य प्रभुरप्युत।
अस्मिन्न्योद्धा च मनोज्ञे विधिच्छेदो विद्यते।।15.2।।

translated_text: The form of this tree is not perceived here, nor its end, nor beginning, nor sustenance. Having cut this firmly rooted Ashvattha tree with the strong axe of detachment,
original_text:
न रूपमस्येह तथोपलभ्यते नान्तो न चादिर्न च सम्प्रतिष्ठा।
अश्वत्थमेनं विवृतं चेदं बुत्वा प्रज्ञालेन बुभुत्सेयम्।।15.3।।

translated_text: One should seek refuge in that from which the cosmic form spreads forth. Having known that primeval Purusha, one attains liberation.
original_text:
तद्यदन्यथा सङ्कल्प्यमेतच्छेद्विचिन्वते।
तदुभयं यदस्योर्ध्वं बुत्वा मुच्येत कुन्तिजः।।15.4।।

translated_text: Rising with the eye of knowledge, abandoning pride, having conquered the evils of attachment, one is freed from birth and death and reaches the supreme state.
original_text:
ज्ञाननेत्रं समारुह्य विरक्तिध्वजिनः श्रिया।
ततः पापाद्विमुच्येत विश्वाद् विश्वनुपालनात्।।15.5।।

translated_text: The sun does not shine there, nor the moon, nor fire. Having reached that supreme abode of Mine, one does not return.
original_text:
न तद्भासयते सूर्यो न शशाङ्को न पावकः।
यद्गत्वा न निवर्तन्ते तद्धाम परमं मम।।15.6।।

translated_text: An eternal fragment of Me has become the living being in the world of life, attracting the mind and five senses which belong to Prakriti.
original_text:
ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः।
मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति।।15.7।।

translated_text: When the soul obtains a body and when it leaves it, it carries these senses and mind as the wind carries scents from their source.
original_text:
शरीरं यदवाप्नोति यच्चाप्युत्क्रामतेश्वरः।
गृहीत्वैनिन्द्रियाणि धायातेन तथा चरम्।।15.8।।

translated_text: It presides over the ear, eye, touch, taste, and smell, as well as the mind, enjoying the sense-objects through them.
original_text:
श्रोत्रं चक्षुः स्पर्शनं च रसनं घ्राणमेव च।
अधिष्ठाय मनश्चायं विषयानुपसेवते।।15.9।।

translated_text: The deluded do not perceive the soul departing, dwelling, or enjoying, but those with the eye of knowledge perceive.
original_text:
उत्क्रामन्तं स्थितं वाऽपि भुञ्जानं वा गुणान्वितम्।
विमूढा नानुपश्यन्ति पश्यन्ति ज्ञानचक्षुषः।।15.10।।

translated_text: The striving yogis see this soul established within themselves, but the unrefined and self-uncontrolled do not perceive it, even though striving.
original_text:
यतन्तो योगिनश्चैनं पश्यन्त्यात्मन्यवस्थितम्।
यतन्तोऽप्यकृतात्मानो नैनं पश्यन्त्यचेतसः।।15.11।।

translated_text: The brilliance of the sun that illumines the entire universe, and the brilliance in the moon and in fire — know that that radiance is Mine.
original_text:
यदादित्यगतं तेजो जगद्भासयतेऽखिलम्।
यच्चन्द्रमसि यच्चाग्नौ तत्तेजो विद्धि मामकम्।।15.12।।

translated_text: Entering the earth, I sustain all beings with My power. Becoming the life-giving Soma, I nourish all herbs.
original_text:
गामाविश्य च भूतानि धारयाम्यहमोजसा।
पुष्णामि चौषधीः सर्वाः सोमो भूत्वा रसायनः।।15.13।।

translated_text: Becoming the digestive fire Vaisvanara in the stomachs of all beings, uniting with the outgoing and incoming breaths, I digest the four kinds of food.
original_text:
अहं वैश्वानरो भूत्वा प्राणिनां देहमाश्रितः।
प्राणापानसमायुक्तः पचाम्यन्नं चतुर्विधम्।।15.14।।

translated_text: I am seated in the hearts of all beings. From Me come memory, knowledge, and forgetfulness. I am that which is to be known by all the Vedas; I am the author of the Vedas and the knower of the Vedas.
original_text:
सर्वस्य चाहं हृदि सन्निविष्टो मत्तः स्मृतिर्ज्ञानमपोहनं च।
वेदैश्च सर्वैरहमेव वेद्यो वेदान्तकृद्वेदविदेव चाहम्।।15.15।।

translated_text: There are two Purushas in this world — the perishable and the imperishable. All beings are perishable; the unchanging is called imperishable.
original_text:
द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके क्षरश्चाक्षर एव च।
क्षरः सर्वाणि भूतानि कूटस्थोऽक्षर उच्यते।।15.16।।

translated_text: The Supreme Purusha, called the Supreme Self, is the eternal Lord, transcending all. He enters the three worlds, sustains them, and is the Lord of all.
original_text:
उत्तमः पुरुषस्त्वन्तः परमोऽव्ययः।
यत्तद्भूतेषु गीतं च यो लोके त्रियधीश्वरः।।15.17।।

translated_text: Because I transcend the perishable and am beyond the imperishable, I am known in the world and in the Vedas as the Supreme Purusha.
original_text:
यस्मात्क्षरमतीतोऽहमक्षरादपि उत्तमः।
यस्माद्यस्माच्च विश्वेन समश्चोच्यते परम्।।15.18।।

translated_text: He who sees Me in everything and everything in Me, without delusion — he is united with Me and I am with him.
original_text:
यो मामव्यभिचारेण सर्वभूतेषु सर्वदा।
सर्वान् पश्यति तत्त्वेन स तत्त्वेन पश्यति।।15.19।।

translated_text: This is the most secret knowledge, thus spoken by Me, O sinless one. Having understood this, one becomes wise and has fulfilled all one's duties.
original_text:
इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ।
एतज्ज्ञानं समाहित्य मम ज्ञानेन चेदृशम्।।15.20।।

translated_text: Fearlessness, purity of mind, steadfastness in knowledge and yoga, charity, self-control, sacrifice, study of scriptures, austerity, and straightforwardness.
original_text:
अभयं सत्त्वसंशुद्धिर्ज्ञानव्यवस्थितिश्छता।
दानं दमश्च यज्ञश्च स्वाध्यायस्तप आर्जवम्।।16.1।।

translated_text: Non-violence, truth, non-anger, renunciation, peace, absence of fault-finding, compassion toward beings, modesty, absence of fickleness, and radiance.
original_text:
अहिंसा सत्यमक्रोधस्त्यागः शान्तिरपैशुनम्।
जातिदान्तिर्मार्दवं ह्रीरचापल्यं विभीषणा।।16.2।।

translated_text: Energy, forgiveness, fortitude, purity, absence of pride — these, O Arjuna, are the marks of one born with divine qualities.
original_text:
तेजः क्षमा धृतिर्नाम्यदर्पोऽनाविलेपता।
महर्षयस्तच्छिष्या एव दैवी सम्पद्विभागशः।।16.3।।

translated_text: The demoniac qualities are hypocrisy, arrogance, pride, anger, harshness, and ignorance — these, O Arjuna, belong to one born with demoniac tendencies.
original_text:
दम्भो दर्पोऽभिमानश्च क्रोधः पारुष्यमेव च।
अज्ञानं चाभिजातस्य पार्थ सम्पद्दासुरी।।16.4।।

translated_text: The divine qualities lead to liberation; the demoniac to bondage. Do not grieve, O Arjuna; you are born with divine qualities.
original_text:
दैवी सम्पद्विमोक्षाय निबन्धायासुरी मता।
मा शोकं कुरु वै पार्थ न त्वं सुप्रभासिषे।।16.5।।

translated_text: Two kinds of beings were created in this world — the divine and the demoniac. The divine have been described at length; hear of the demoniac from Me, O Partha.
original_text:
द्वौ भूतसर्गौ लोकेऽस्मिन्दैव आसुर एव च।
दैवो विस्तरशः प्रोक्त आसुरं पार्थ मे शृणु।।16.6।।

translated_text: The demoniac people do not understand what is right action and what is renunciation. There is no purity, no self-discipline, no truth, and no faith in them.
original_text:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च जना न विदुरासुराः।
शौचं नास्ति न तत्पात्रं न श्रद्दा न च श्रुतम्।।16.7।।

translated_text: They say the universe is unreal, without foundation, without God, generated by desire alone, with no cause other than lust.
original_text:
असत्यमप्रतिष्ठं ते जगदाहुरनीश्वरम्।
अपरस्परसम्भूतं किमन्यत्कामहैतुकम्।।16.8।।

translated_text: Thus lost, possessed by unrighteousness, these foolish people come to destruction, O Arjuna, as well as those who follow them.
original_text:
तेमां दृष्ट्वावृत्ताच्छ्मा नाशमापन्नाः परम्परा।
कामाभिसन्धानकृतः प्राहन्योनिषु पश्यसि।।16.9।।

translated_text: Bound by hundreds of ties of desire and driven by lust and anger, they accumulate impure wealth by unjust means for the gratification of their senses.
original_text:
काममाश्रित्य दुष्पूरं दम्भमानमदान्विताः।
मोहात्गृह्यासते कर्माणि विद्धि दोषविदुर्विदाः।।16.10।।

translated_text: Self-satisfied, driven by lust, arrogance, and intoxication, they perform ostentatious sacrifices in name only, not according to scriptural injunctions.
original_text:
आत्मसम्भाविताः स्तब्धा धनमानमदान्विताः।
यजन्ते नामयज्ञैस्ते दम्भेनाविधिपूर्वकम्।।16.11।।

translated_text: Abiding in egoism, strength, pride, lust, and anger, these malicious people store up wealth through unrighteous means.
original_text:
अहङ्कारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं च संश्रिताः।
महामात्रोमहाक्रूरा साधनां श्रेष्ठमास्थिताः।।16.12।।

translated_text: Today I have gained this; by this desire I shall fulfill that wish. This wealth is mine, and that shall also be mine.
original_text:
इदमद्य न नश्यति हत्वा वा भविता हतौ।
इमं लोकं न जित्वा कस्मान्मे प्रमदिष्यति।।16.13।।

translated_text: This enemy I have slain; this other I shall also slay. I am the enjoyer; I am powerful; I am the lord.
original_text:
इमं लोकं जित्वा कस्मान्मे प्रमदिष्यति।
को ह्यस्मान्मे व्यतिपारो न विमुञ्चेत्कर्मतः।।16.14।।

translated_text: I am rich, I am well-born, who is my equal? I shall sacrifice, I shall give, I shall rejoice." Thus deluded by ignorance,
original_text:
अधिष्ठानं च तान्पश्य हित्वावैकान्तरिक्षतम्।
स्वर्गद्वारं पापमार्गजुष्टं पश्य विद्वत्तमा।।16.15।।

translated_text: Bewildered by pride, lust, and intoxication, they perform sacrifices with hypocrisy, not according to scriptural rules.
original_text:
अस्वर्ग्यमकीर्तिकरमकल्पविवर्जितम्।
अनन्तश्चास्मि लोकेऽस्मिन्किं कर्म समाहिताः।।16.16।।

translated_text: Deluded by egotism, thinking 'I am the doer,' such foolish people are bound by the chains of karma.
original_text:
अहङ्कारविमूढात्मा कर्ताहमिति मन्यते।
क्रताञ्च लोकानुशसन् कर्मणि निबध्यते।।16.17।।

translated_text: Those who are enmeshed in lust and anger, who are devoted to the gratification of their desires, descend to the lowest hells.
original_text:
कामक्रोधपरीतानां येऽन्तः प्रविष्टा गाहिनः।
उभयस्य हिंसित्वा नरकं तेऽधिगच्छति।।16.18।।

translated_text: Those who are envious, cruel, and the worst among men — I hurl them repeatedly into hells, into the cycles of birth and death.
original_text:
तानहं द्विषतः क्रूरान्संसारेषु नराधमान्।
क्षिपाम्यजस्रशबीष्मेष्वन्धतामसोत्सुकेषु।।16.19।।

translated_text: Bound by the sinful desires of lust and anger, such people fall into the darkest hells, one after another.
original_text:
कामासुरीष्वनित्यवृत्तं पापमाश्रिताः।
नरकान् नरकानुश्रेष्ठान् प्राप्नुवन्ति मनुष्याः।।16.20।।

translated_text: Three gates lead to the hell of self-destruction — lust, anger, and greed. Therefore, one should abandon these three.
original_text:
त्रिविधं नरकस्येदं द्वारं नाशनमात्मनः।
कामः क्रोधस्तथा लोभस्तस्मादेतत्त्रयं त्यजेत्।।16.21।।

translated_text: One who is freed from these three gates of darkness performs what is good for the self and attains the supreme goal.
original_text:
य एतत्त्रयमुत्सृज्य मुच्यते कर्मबन्धनैः।
स दिव्यं सम्पदानन्तं याति प्रेत्य चामृतम्।।16.22।।

translated_text: One who discards the injunctions of scripture and acts according to the impulses of desire attains neither perfection, nor happiness, nor the supreme goal.
original_text:
यः शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य वर्तते कामकारतः।
स सिद्धिं न विन्दति न सुखं न परां गतिम्।।16.23।।

translated_text: Therefore, let scripture be your authority in determining what should and should not be done. Having known the scriptural injunctions, you should perform action in this world.
original_text:
तस्माच्छास्त्रं प्रमाणं ते कार्याकार्यव्यवस्थितौ।
ज्ञात्वा शास्त्रविधानोक्तं कर्म कर्तुमिहार्हसि।।16.24।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: Those who, abandoning the injunctions of scripture, perform sacrifices with faith — what is their status, O Krishna? Is it of sattva, rajas, or tamas?
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः।
तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो तमो गुणाः।।17.1।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: The faith of the embodied is of three kinds, born of one's own nature — sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic. Hear of them.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्दा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा।
सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु।।17.2।।

translated_text: Every being's faith corresponds to their nature, O Arjuna. A person is made of their faith. As is one's faith, so is one.
original_text:
सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्दा भवति भारत।
श्रद्दामयो यमयुक्तस्तद्भक्तो लभते फलम्।।17.3।।

translated_text: People of sattva worship the gods; those of rajas worship the yakshas and rakshasas; those of tamas worship the spirits of the dead and ghostly hosts.
original_text:
यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः।
प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः।।17.4।।

translated_text: Those who, discarding the injunctions of scripture, perform sacrifices with self-will, driven by ego and bound by the elements of nature.
original_text:
अशास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः।
विद्धानां बुद्धिः संमोहे भूत्वा बन्धनमाश्रिताः।।17.5।।

translated_text: The fruit of such actions performed under the influence of the three gunas is temporary, and limited to this world.
original_text:
कष्टोऽपि कर्मकृत्तेषां दम्भारम्भकर्मतः।
क्रोधापरियुक्तास्ते राजसे प्रियाः।।17.6।।

translated_text: Those who are non-violent, truthful, free from anger, renouncing, peaceful, devoted to the Supreme — their worship is sattvic.
original_text:
अहिंसरा सत्यस्थाः स्थिरास्त्यागिनः।
शान्तादिष्ठाः समाहितास्ते सात्त्विके प्रियाः।।17.7।।

translated_text: Those who perform sacrifices with ostentation and pride, driven by egoism and possessed by lust and anger — their worship is rajasic.
original_text:
दम्भारम्भकर्मास्था मदोऽभिमनाविताः।
क्रोधापरियुक्तास्ते राजसे प्रियाः।।17.8।।

translated_text: The worship of those who are foolish, ignorant, and of tamasic nature, with improper rituals, is not proper.
original_text:
विप्रर्षभाः पशुसंनिवेशनाः।
स्वाहाकाराः प्रतिष्ठा ह्यस्ति विद्या च मदर्पिता।।17.9।।

translated_text: That food which is dear to all three is of three kinds, as also sacrifice, austerity, and charity. Hear the distinction.
original_text:
अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्तस्यापि देहिनाम्।
स्वकर्मतिरस्कृतानां भोजनं तैस्तमोविधम्।।17.10।।

translated_text: Foods that promote life, vitality, strength, health, happiness, and that are agreeable and sustaining — these are loved by the sattvic.
original_text:
अप्रोक्तं पौष्टिकं शुष्कं पिष्टं विविधमाश्रितम्।
तद् भक्त्युपहृतं सत्त्विकं प्रियतमं भवति।।17.11।।

translated_text: Foods that are bitter, sour, salty, very hot, pungent, dry, and burning — these are liked by the rajasic and produce pain and sorrow.
original_text:
कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः।
आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः।।17.12।।

translated_text: Foods that are stale, tasteless, putrid, decomposed, as well as leavings and unclean food — these are loved by the tamasic.
original_text:
यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत्।
उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम्।।17.13।।

translated_text: That austerity performed with great faith by self-controlled people, solely to please the Supreme Lord, is sattvic austerity.
original_text:
यत्तपस्यन्ति ते ह्यष्टौ विद्धानां बुद्धिसंमतम्।
शास्त्रविद्धां समाहिता देवद्विजगुरुप्रियम्।।17.14।।

translated_text: The austerity practiced with great show for gaining respect and honor, or with self-torture — that is declared to be rajasic.
original_text:
दम्भारम्भाभियुक्तैस्तु दुःखेनात्मैनोनुगमे।
यत्तपस्यन्ति वैरिण्ये तद् राजसमुदाहृतम्।।17.15।।

translated_text: The austerity performed with foolish obstinity, for self-torture or for destroying another — that is declared to be tamasic.
original_text:
मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः।
परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम्।।17.16।।

translated_text: Charity given with the feeling that it must be given, without expectation of return, at the proper place and time, to a worthy person — such charity is sattvic.
original_text:
दातव्यमिति यत्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे।
देशे काले च पात्रे च दानं सात्त्विकमुच्यते।।17.17।।

translated_text: Charity given with a view to receiving in return, looking for the fruit, or done reluctantly — such charity is rajasic.
original_text:
दानं चैवात्मनः कामाद् दानमिष्टार्थसाधनम्।
यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः।।17.18।।

translated_text: Charity given at an improper place and time, to unworthy persons, without respect — such charity is tamasic.
original_text:
अदेशकाले पात्रे च दानं तामसमुच्यते।
अप्रत्युपकृतं चापि दानं तामसमुच्यते।।17.19।।

translated_text: The syllable Om, Tat, and Sat are designated as the threefold name of Brahman. By that, the Brahmins, the Vedas, and the sacrifices were created.
original_text:
ॐ तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः।
ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा।।17.20।।

translated_text: Therefore, with the utterance of Om, acts of sacrifice, austerity, and charity are begun, as enjoined by the scriptural injunctions.
original_text:
तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।
प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ता सत्त्वं शुद्धिकराः परे।।17.21।।

translated_text: Without seeking the fruit, acts of sacrifice, austerity, and charity are performed by seekers of liberation, uttering Tat.
original_text:
तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।
दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः।।17.22।।

translated_text: The word Sat denotes both the eternal and the good. Similarly, it is used in acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity.
original_text:
सत्प्रियम्।
यद् द्विजोत्तमाः तद् भक्त्या भुञ्जते नरा यतः।।17.23।।

translated_text: Therefore, with the utterance of Om, acts of sacrifice, austerity, and charity are begun by those who desire liberation.
original_text:
तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः।
प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ता सत्त्वं शुद्धिकराः परे।।17.24।।

translated_text: Without seeking the fruit, acts of sacrifice, austerity, and charity are performed by seekers of liberation, uttering Tat.
original_text:
तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः।
दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः।।17.25।।

translated_text: The word Sat denotes the supreme good. The use of Sat is prescribed for acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity in this world.
original_text:
सद्भावे साधुभावे च स्थितिः सत्सम्प्रदर्शिता।
तस्मात्सत्सु कृतं तत्र लोकेऽस्मिन्दानतपःक्रियाः।।17.26।।

translated_text: Whatever is done without faith — whether sacrifice, gift, or austerity — is called Asat. It is of no use here or hereafter.
original_text:
श्रद्धा विधिमुत्सृज्य यत्कृतं तत्तमोविधम्।
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न कतर्युत्नोति नो नृप।।17.27।।

translated_text: Whatever is done without faith — sacrifice, charity, or austerity — is called Asat, O Arjuna. It is of no worth here or hereafter.
original_text:
अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत्।
असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न कतर्युत्नोति नो नृप।।17.28।।

translated_text: Arjuna said: O mighty-armed one, I desire to understand the truth of sannyasa (renunciation) and tyaga (renunciation of fruits). O best among the knowers of truth, O Krishna.
original_text:
अर्जुन उवाच
संन्यासस्य महाबाहो तत्त्वमिच्छामि वेदितम्।
त्यागस्य च श्रीकृष्ण पच्छामि श्रेष्ठतत्त्ववित्।।18.1।।

translated_text: The Blessed Lord said: The renunciation of actions done with desire is called sannyasa by the learned. The abandonment of the fruits of all actions is called tyaga by the wise.
original_text:
श्रीभगवानुवाच
काम्यानां कर्मणां न्यासं संन्यासं कवयो विदुः।
सर्वकर्मफलत्यागं प्राहुस्त्यागं विचक्षणाः।।18.2।।

translated_text: Some wise people say that all actions should be abandoned as being tainted by evil. Others declare that acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity should not be abandoned.
original_text:
त्याज्यं दोषवदित्येके कर्म प्राहुर्मनीषिणः।
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यमिति चापरे।।18.3।।

translated_text: O best among the Bharatas, hear from Me the conclusive truth about tyaga. Tyaga, O tiger among men, is of three kinds.
original_text:
निश्चयं श्रूणु मे तत्र त्यागे भरतसत्तम।
त्यागो हि पुरुषव्याघ्र त्रिविधः सम्प्रकीर्तितः।।18.4।।

translated_text: Acts of sacrifice, charity, and austerity should not be abandoned; they must indeed be performed. Sacrifice, charity, and austerity are purifying actions for the wise.
original_text:
यज्ञदानतपःकर्म न त्याज्यं कार्यमेव तत्।
यज्ञो दानं तपश्चैव पावनानि मनीषिणाम्।।18.5।।

translated_text: But even these actions should be performed, O Arjuna, abandoning attachment and desire for results. This is My certain and best opinion.
original_text:
एतान्यपि तु कर्माणि सङ्गं त्यक्त्वा फलानि च।
कर्तव्यानीति मे पार्थ निश्चितं मतमुत्तमम्।।18.6।।

translated_text: The renunciation of obligatory actions is not proper. The abandonment of them out of delusion is called tamasic renunciation.
original_text:
नियतस्य तु संन्यासं कर्मणो नोपपद्यते।
मोहात्तस्य परित्यागस्तामसः परिकीर्तितः।।18.7।।

translated_text: Whoever abandons action merely because it causes suffering, out of desire for pleasure, such a rajasic abandonment is never true renunciation.
original_text:
दुःखमित्येव यत्कर्म सुखकाङ्क्षी त्यजति कृत्।
राजसं परित्यागं नैव त्यागं फललिप्सया।।18.8।।

translated_text: O Brahmins, when one performs action as a duty, abandoning attachment and the desire for results, such abandonment is considered sattvic.
original_text:
कार्यमित्येव यत्कर्म नियतं संन्यस्य च।
संन्यासं कुरु विप्राणि स त्यागः सात्त्विको मतः।।18.9।।

translated_text: The sattvic renouncer neither hates disagreeable action nor is attached to agreeable action. He is free from all dualities and possesses firm knowledge.
original_text:
न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म सुकर्मण्यपि च हन्ति सः।
न द्वेष्ट्यकुशलं कर्म सुकर्मण्यपि च हन्ति च।
कर्ता सात्त्विकः प्रोक्तः।।18.10।।

translated_text: For a embodied being, it is not possible to completely abandon all actions. One who renounces the fruits of action is truly called a renouncer.
original_text:
न हि देहभृता शक्यं त्यक्तुं कर्माण्यशेषतः।
यस्त्यत्कर्मफलत्यागी स त्यागीत्यभिधीयते।।18.11।।

translated_text: Those who do not desire fruitive results do not enjoy the good or suffer the evil results. The firm determination of the wise is not attained by the uninitiated.
original_text:
